content.short: Camels House is a community-driven P2E game on TON featuring the $CAMELS token and NFT rewards.
content.description: Camels House is a vibrant and social-led Play-to-Earn game built on the TON blockchain and accessible as a Telegram Mini App. It invites players to engage in a variety of daily tasks, interactive airdrops, and a 'lucky spin' mechanic to earn $CAMELS tokens. The project also features a unique NFT system where digital camels serve as productive assets for their holders. By fostering a playful and highly engaged community, Camels House provides a fun and rewarding entry point for users to explore the benefits of digital ownership and social gaming within the flourishing TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Join the herd at Camels House on TON. Play, earn, and collect unique NFTs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
content.pageTitle: Camels House - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
